A __________ integrity constraint requires that the values appearing in specified attributes of any tuple in the referencing relation also appear in specified attributes of at least one tuple in the referenced relation.
Which one of the following is a procedural language ?
Identify which of the following operation contains all pairs of tuples from the two relations, regardless of whether their attribute values match.
The basic data type char(n) is a __________ length character string and varchar(n) is __________ length character.
To remove a relation from an SQL database, we use the __________ command.
__________ clause is an additional filter that is applied to the result.
Which of the following deletes all tuples in the instructor relation for those instructors associated with a department located in the MilleniumCenter building which is in department relation.

opts.A:
DELETE FROM instructor
WHERE dept_name IN ‘ MilleniumCenter ‘;
opts.B:
DELETE FROM department
WHERE building=’ MilleniumCenter ‘;
opts.C:
DELETE FROM instructor
WHERE dept_name IN (SELECT dept name
FROM department
WHERE building = ’ MilleniumCenter’);

questions.note: Options print one per line (not two-column). Paper's own typography preserved: option (c) prints `SELECT dept name` with a space where `dept_name` is meant, and the string quoting mixes ‘ and ’ glyphs with stray spaces inside the quotes.
